items.exampleEn: Doctors spend hours on paperwork every week.
items.exampleZh: 醫生每週要花好幾個小時處理文書工作。

items.exampleEn: The factory pays workers extra for overtime.
items.exampleZh: 那家工廠會額外支付工人加班費。

items.exampleEn: The museum gives each visitor a free booklet about the paintings.
items.exampleZh: 博物館會送每位參觀者一本介紹畫作的免費小冊子。

items.exampleEn: Her father is a top executive at a car company.
items.exampleZh: 她父親是一家汽車公司的高階主管。

items.exampleEn: The supermarket has more than two hundred employees.
items.exampleZh: 那家超市有兩百多名員工。

items.exampleEn: The conference ended with a short speech by the mayor.
items.exampleZh: 研討會最後由市長發表簡短演說作結。

items.exampleEn: The procedure for opening a bank account is quite simple.
items.exampleZh: 開銀行帳戶的手續相當簡單。

items.exampleEn: I often have lunch with my colleagues from the design team.
items.exampleZh: 我常和設計組的同事一起吃午餐。

items.sentenceEn: All new employees must attend safety training on Monday.
items.sentenceZh: 所有新進員工星期一都必須參加安全訓練。

items.audioEn: Sorry, I can't join you for dinner tonight, because I have to work overtime again.
items.audioZh: 抱歉，我今晚不能和你們吃晚餐，因為我又得加班了。
items.questionZh: 說話者今晚為什麼不能去吃飯？

items.sentenceEn: Two of my colleagues are getting married next month.
items.sentenceZh: 我有兩位同事下個月要結婚了。

items.sentenceEn: The executive flew to Tokyo to sign a deal with a new partner.
items.sentenceZh: 那位主管飛到東京，和新的合作夥伴簽約。

items.stemEn: Starting a new job usually means a lot of ____: forms, contracts and copies of your passport.
items.stemZh: 開始一份新工作通常意味著一大堆文書手續：表格、合約和護照影本。

items.stemEn: Before you use the new machine, read the safety ____ on the wall next to it.
items.stemZh: 使用新機器前，請先讀旁邊牆上的安全操作步驟。

items.passageEn: Last year, many employees at our company were unhappy. They often worked overtime, and much of their time went to paperwork instead of real tasks. After a survey, the executives decided to change things. First, they made the procedure for buying office supplies much simpler. Then they gave every new worker a short booklet with clear rules about working hours. At this year's sales conference, the boss said that working late should be a choice, not an obligation. Now most of my colleagues go home by six, and they seem much happier.
items.passageZh: 去年，我們公司很多員工都不開心。他們常常加班，而且很多時間都花在文書工作上，而不是真正的任務。做完問卷調查後，主管們決定做些改變。首先，他們把採購辦公用品的流程簡化許多。接著，他們發給每位新員工一本小冊子，清楚說明工作時間的規定。在今年的業務大會上，老闆說晚點下班應該是一種選擇，而不是義務。現在我大部分的同事六點前就下班了，看起來開心多了。

questions.questionZh: 主管們首先改變了什麼？
老闆在今年的業務大會上說了什麼？

items.promptZh: 下個月我要去新加坡參加一場研討會。
referenceEn: Next month, I am going to a conference in Singapore.
I will attend a conference in Singapore next month.
rubricZh: 「研討會」可寫，例如 conference 等
「參加」可寫，例如 go to、attend 等
未來的事用表示未來的寫法（例如 am going to、will、am attending 等）

items.instructionZh: 用 colleague 造一個句子，說說一位同事幫過你的一件事。
referenceEn: My colleague helped me fix my computer when it stopped working.
A colleague of mine taught me how to use the new software.
rubricZh: 寫法不限（例如 my colleague、a colleague of mine 等）
時態配合內容（例如 helped、taught 等）
